name: Emerging Display Technologies Corp.
summary: Emerging Display Technologies Corp. (EDT) functions as a global manufacturer and supplier of advanced display solutions, specializing in capacitive touch panels and a wide variety of liquid crystal displays (LCDs). The company's market presence spans Taiwan, Europe, the United States, and other international regions. EDT's product portfolio encompasses numerous LCD technologies, such as Thin-Film Transistor (TFT), Super-Twisted Nematic (STN) for both character and graphic applications, Film Super-Twisted Nematic (FSTN), and TFT integrated with capacitive touch capabilities. These display solutions are engineered using diverse methods for driver electronics integration, including chip on glass (COG), chip on board (COB), chip on flex (COF), tape automated bonding (TAB), and flexible printed circuit board (FPCB) modules. Beyond its core display offerings, EDT also develops smart embedded modules. These components are designed to manage display and touchscreen functionalities, supporting various interface protocols. EDT's technologies find extensive application across numerous sectors, including industrial automation, smart home systems, medical and healthcare apparatus, portable electronic devices, and information appliances. Established in 1983, Emerging Display Technologies Corp. maintains its corporate headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
